content:
rapidly approaching failure
My life is actual shit. I’m going to fail school and life, just like I’ve done in classes years past. Graduation is in May and I’m not going to make it.

I struggle with school, I try. Then I get sent to the hospital for an “ED” that was never properly treated thanks to my mom and shit therapist. Gone from October to December. Entire semester missed. Terrible experience, never got any compassion while hooked to machines from my family. Just screamed at.

Since then it’s been more hellish than the loneliness and failure I already had. Online school offers nothing, more invisible than I was when I was even present. Twin brother never encountered any bumps, made it into an Ivy, loads of friends, is somebody. Yet all the while I get berated for not applying when I was literally hospitalized. Told I’ll be a baby mama if I don’t graduate with my class. I’m too behind despite my all nighters and tears, so guess that’s all I’ll be!

The same “it gets better, just wait,” is so untrue. Helplines daily, therapists, guidance counselors for school help. 4+ years. If college doesn’t offer any change, then that’s it for me!
